# ProGrafter

> UK construction trust platform matching reviewed homeowner project briefs with verified tradespeople. No subscription to join, get matched, quote, or get paid — ever. Optional paid tools are separate, opt-in add-ons. Trades pay 7.5% only after completed paid work, capped at £900 per job.

ProGrafter is built by Lee Palfreeman, an electrician of 20 years. The platform handles job briefs, trade verification, quote review, milestone records, variation sign-off, shared project records and guidance about green-energy grant schemes. Automated homeowner payment collection and contract signing are not yet live.
